description: Deterministic rule-based inference; no trained classifier.

impact: Cannot interpret scores as confidence percentages.

description: TOP_CANDIDATE is an inferred occupation, not ground truth.

system_behavior: No current/past role selection or recency weighting.
downstream_handling: Do not describe inference as current employment.

description: Generic and broad official aliases remain difficult.
impact: False alternatives or abstention remain possible.

impact: Literal core matching may miss nuance.

impact: Useful support alternatives may be lost.

description: Some useful engineering alternatives may be over-pruned.

description: Deep Learning Engineer Intern may abstain.

description: No external semantic or embedding model is used.

description: CV skills support inference but do not prove occupation.
